content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states only that 'the Agency concluded that Complainant failed to prove that he was subjected to discrimination as alleged,' and gives no evidence, analysis, or reasoning linking the allegations to that conclusion, so the path to it cannot be reconstructed."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Some items cite sources (ROI at 246-7 for the IG report, ROI at 49-51 for claim acceptance and dismissal), and allegations such as (k) are attributed to the HSS relaying SHSS's statement, but most characterizations appear only as Complainant's allegations and the Agency's finding has no identified evidentiary source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Claims (k)-(q) carry approximate dates from April 15 to August 10, 2018, though listed in reverse order, while accepted claims (a)-(b), the background incidents (c)-(j), and the procedural steps (ROI issuance, hearing request and withdrawal, final decision, appeal) are undated or absent from the fragment."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The final decision is attributed only to 'the Agency' under 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b), with no identified decision-maker, no stated legal standard or analytical framework, and no indication that responses from SHSS or other witnesses were considered."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"The summary is fragmentary: claims (a)-(j) are missing, the text cuts off mid-citation, there is no merits analysis, and RC1 and RC4 are not met, so an independent reviewer could not assess whether the no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
